verdict.rationale: A package manager could plausibly offer AI-driven suggestions, for example about dependencies or upgrades, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents any AI-generated insights or suggestions. Deterministic reports like `bun audit`, `bun outdated` and `bun why` are adjacent, non-AI features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
